title: Implement runtime decision adapter and MessageEnvelope validation schemas
verify: Raw model/provider output cannot bypass runtime decision and MessageEnvelope validation.
Malformed, overlong, unsafe, secret-containing, or out-of-profile output is rejected, downgraded, escalated, or recorded with trace evidence.
evidence_required: MessageEnvelope schema validation tests for allowed decisions, claim types, safety flags, refs, trace refs, redaction status, and publication flags.
Negative tests for raw output bypass and secret-like payloads.
constraints: Every agent invocation ends with exactly one project-owned runtime decision.
Raw provider output alone cannot choose publication authority.
invariants: Raw provider output, hidden reasoning, unapproved governance content, UI markdown, and secrets are rejected before envelope creation.
Agent-labeled hypotheses cannot become confirmed Plant state without owning runtime/state rules and human/follow-up evidence.
verification_targets: MessageEnvelope validation and raw output bypass regression.
